name: Aehobak (Cucurbita moschata) greenhouse optimum, literature-based

derivation.day_08_17: Tdb 23.5 = centre of 22-25 degC day optimum (Goo et al. 2022; Jeju ARES guide 23-25); VPD 1.0 = centre of 0.5-1.5 kPa (Yu et al. 2023)
derivation.night_19_06: Tdb 14 = centre of 13-15 degC night optimum (Goo et al. 2022; Jeju ARES guide 12-15); VPD 0.5 kPa, lower bound 0.3 kPa (Shamshiri et al. 2018)
derivation.transition_07_18: linear midpoint of day and night values
derivation.day_night_hours: assumption: 08-17 day, 19-06 night (March sunrise about 06:40, sunset about 18:50 at Muan)
derivation.default_zone_tolerances: tTol 1.5 degC (day 22-25, night 12.5-15.5), vpdTol 0.5 kPa, vpdMin 0.3 kPa (day 0.5-1.5, night 0.3-1.0)

references: Goo HW, Kim EJ, Na HY, Park KS (2022) Effects of heating initiative temperature and CO2 fertilizing concentration on the growth and yield of summer squash in a greenhouse. J Bio-Environ Control 31(4):468-475. doi:10.12791/KSBEC.2022.31.4.468
Yu X, Zhang Y, Zhao X, Li J (2023) Systemic effects of the vapor pressure deficit on the physiology and productivity of protected vegetables. Vegetable Research 3:20. doi:10.48130/VR-2023-0020

Shamshiri RR, Jones JW, Thorp KR, Ahmad D, Che Man H, Taheri S (2018) Review of optimum temperature, humidity, and vapour pressure deficit for microclimate evaluation and control in greenhouse cultivation of tomato: a review. Int Agrophys 32:287-302. doi:10.1515/intag-2017-0005
Jeju Special Self-Governing Province Agricultural Research and Extension Services. Pumpkin/squash cultivation guide (extension document)
